sender.name: Alex Morgan
sender.background: I run a small search fund and want to buy one established HVAC business in North Texas, keep its team and its name, and run it for the long term.

facts_used: What they do: A/C Service Co. is a family owned North Texas HVAC company providing residential and commercial air conditioning and heating sales, repair, installation and maintenance in the Fort Worth, Arlington and Tarrant County areas.
Founded in 1999, according to their website
Their website says: "As a family owned and operated company, we pride ourselves in honesty, integrity, and quality workmanship."
Their website says: "We offer commercial and residential preventative maintenance agreements."
Their website says: "A/C Service Co. is North Texas’s trusted leader for residential and commercial air conditioning sales and service."

content.text:
{"subject":"Question about A/C Service Co. in Fort Worth","body":"Your site says A/C Service Co. has been family owned and operated in Fort Worth since 1999, doing both residential and commercial work across Tarrant County. Twenty-five-plus years in one market is not a common thing.

I run a small search fund. I'm looking to buy one established HVAC business in North Texas, keep the team and the name, and run it myself for the long term. I'm not a broker and I'm not putting a number in front of you — I don't know enough, and this isn't the kind of decision anyone makes from an email.

I'd just like to learn how you built it, and if you've ever thought about what happens to the company down the road, I'd listen.

If the timing is wrong, or the answer is no, I'll leave it there.

Would you be open to a short phone call in the next few weeks?

Thanks for your time,
Alex Morgan","opening_fact":"A/C Service Co. has been family owned and operated in Fort Worth since 1999, serving residential and commercial customers across Tarrant County.","follow_up":"Alex here again, following up on my note about A/C Service Co. No rush and no need for a long reply — if now isn't the time, just say so and I won't keep writing. If you'd rather talk in a few months, that's fine too."}
